task: Prevent orphan skill records in SkillService.create_skill by validating companion payloads before SkillRepository.create and deleting the created record (log-and-swallow cleanup errors, re-raise original) if upload/update fails afterwards.

key_reasoning.reason: Compensating-delete (saga-like) around a non-transactional DB plus blob sequence, and extracting validation from an interleaved loop in _upload_companion_files without changing update_skill error codes, messages or ordering. Existing patterns (static service methods, ExtendedHTTPException) cover most of it, so it stays at M.
Single component, SkillService (create_skill, _upload_companion_files, new _validate_companion_payloads helper). SkillRepository.delete and SkillFileStorage are consumed unchanged.
